scope: read-only source validation; no production cache, configuration, source data, or application code was changed

trigger_and_expected_behavior.trigger: Validate the frozen BTC-USDT-SWAP five-minute source used by the 1h Parabolic-RSI / 5m six-MA study.
trigger_and_expected_behavior.expected: 324288 confirmed, continuous UTC five-minute OHLCV rows from 2023-08-20T21:00:00Z through exclusive 2026-09-19T21:00:00Z; receipt SHA and provenance reconcile; 1h aggregation agrees with public OKX history-candles prices; event identities do not depend on 30 versus a longer available prefix.
trigger_and_expected_behavior.observed: The frozen source meets those checks. The older preholdout snapshot has one row missing before the frozen source begins; it does not affect frozen data, and an in-memory same-venue read of that row restored an exact 90-day sensitivity prefix without changing any evaluation-window RSI or strong event.

public_okx_1h_crosscheck.request: instId=BTC-USDT-SWAP, bar=1H, after=(sample open plus one hour), limit=5
public_okx_1h_crosscheck.volume_difference_interpretation: IEEE-754 summation representation only; the request permits tiny archive-volume float differences and all prices match exactly.

rsi14_and_strong_event_prefix_sensitivit.implementation: _rsi_wilder(hourly.close, 14), then pine_sar and diamonds; strong events use SAR thresholds as implemented in yoyo/evaluation/parabolic_rsi_sar.py.

existing_nominal_90_day_prefix.result: Not an exact continuous 90-day source from existing files alone.

conclusion.confirmed_nonblocking_archive_defect: The older preholdout archive lacks the single confirmed 5m candle at 2023-06-22T22:15:00Z, so it cannot alone supply a literal continuous 90-day prefix.
conclusion.effect_on_frozen_source_or_evaluation_ev: None observed: frozen data is complete and 30-day versus longer available/exact-90 in-memory prefixes give bit-identical evaluation RSI14 and identical 564 strong events.
conclusion.smallest_proposed_fix: If a durable literal 90-day sensitivity input is required, append only this one same-venue, confirmed raw candle with a receipt and then rerun the source-integrity check. No change is required for the frozen study input or its current event set.
limitations: The public OKX crosscheck samples 19 dispersed one-hour candles; it is not a full independent download.
No native TradingView export or parity assertion was made.
No performance scoring, production interaction, or mutable data repair was performed.
